rationale: Continue torch_toto2 HP sweep: iter #2008 default (ctx=512, hor=64) hit W4 + alive W2 thr=0.55 (+54% ann); iter #2009 nudge (ctx=256, hor=32, decode=128) hit W4 + W1 (FIRST W1 PASS in 20+ iters, 52.4% WR vs 49.7% floor) but lost W2 to over-selective score collapse. Two-axis sweep target: (context_length × horizon) where short-context unlocks W1 and long-context preserves W2 — search_spaces.py already has context_length ∈ [256,512] and horizon ∈ [32,64,96]; train mode should pin pos_weight ≤ 1.5 (per timesfm-pos-weight-2-regresses memory), include_last_row=True (anchor signal), and sweep dropout 0.05-0.30 + head_hidden ∈ [128,256] + lr (3e-4..3e-3) against the (ctx, hor) grid. W3/W5/W6 still 0/20 walls — score collapse to thr=0.0 means HP sweep alone may not crack them; if 5 more iterations don't lift wp above 3, pivot to per-window-conditional encoder (separate calibration heads per regime).
